segments.text: Good morning Mrs Baker, please sit down. Your blood sugar results are a little high.
I want to start you on metformin, five hundred milligrams, twice daily after food.
Take it for three months and then we will review how you are getting on.
Please come back and see me in three months, on a Tuesday if you can.
If you feel very dizzy or you are sick for more than a day, call the clinic straight away.
Do you have any other questions for me today?
